items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Topics 4:1
items.html: After the ascent of the coupling Malchut from the place of the mouth to the place of the half of the Bina of the head, following the purification of the screen to the aspect of phase two of the clothing and to the aspect of phase one of the coarseness, called the aspect of the eyes, then the coupling of striking was made in the place of the openings of the eyes, from where came out the ten Sefirot of Nekudim. (Item 9).
